description_en: Submits a job to add media
name: AddMedia

parameters.help_en:
The path of the input file. You can obtain the path from the MPS or OSS console. For detailed trigger rules, see Workflow trigger matching rules below.

Only OSS HTTP URLs are supported. CDN URLs and HTTPS URLs are not supported.
The URL cannot exceed 3,200 bytes in length.
The URL must comply with RFC 2396 and be encoded in UTF-8 and URL-encoded. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.help_zh:
输入文件的路径，可以通过MPS或OSS控制台获取。详细触发规则请参见下文中工作流触发匹配规则。

仅支持OSS HTTP地址，不支持CDN地址和HTTPS地址。
不超过3200字节。
URL遵循RFC 2396（UTF-8编码，并进行URLEncode）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en:
The title of the media file.

The title cannot exceed 128 bytes in length.
The title must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
媒体标题。

长度限制不超过128个字节。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: title

parameters.help_en:
The description.

The description cannot exceed 1,024 bytes in length.
The description must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
描述。

长度限制不超过1024个字节。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the cover image. This is the storage address of the cover image that you want to set. You can obtain the URL by choosing MPS Console > Workflows > Media Buckets or OSS Console > My Access Paths.

The URL cannot exceed 3,200 bytes in length.
The URL must comply with RFC 2396 and be encoded in UTF-8 and URL-encoded. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.help_zh:
封面URL。即您需要设置的封面的存储地址，可以通过MPS控制台 > 工作流管理 > 媒体Bucket或OSS控制台 > 我的访问路径获取。

不超过3200字节。
URL遵循RFC 2396（UTF-8编码，并进行URLEncode）。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html
parameters.name: cover_url

parameters.help_en:
The list of tags.

In ApsaraVideo Media Processing, each tag of a media file is independent. You can search the Media Library to find all media files that have the same tag.

Separate multiple tags with commas (,). You can specify up to 16 tags.
A single tag cannot exceed 32 bytes in length.

The tags must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
标签列表。

媒体处理中，每个媒体的每个标签都是独立的，可以通过搜索媒体库来查找所有设置了相同标签的媒体。

用半角逗号（,）分隔，不超过16个标签。
单个标签不能超过32个字节。

UTF-8编码
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the media workflow. You can obtain the ID from the MPS console or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44437.html operation.

The task for this parameter is an https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027615.html. After the task is submitted, it is not completed immediately but queued for asynchronous execution in the background
parameters.help_zh:
媒体工作流ID。可通过MPS控制台或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44437.html接口获取。

该参数任务为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3027615.html，提交后任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行
parameters.name: media_workflow_id

parameters.help_en:
The custom user data of the media workflow.

The data cannot exceed 1,024 bytes in length.
The data must be encoded in UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
媒体工作流用户自定义数据。

不超过1024字节。
UTF-8编码
parameters.name: media_workflow_user_data

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to check whether the specified workflow supports the input path. We recommend that you set this parameter to true to avoid errors caused by incorrect paths. Valid values:

true: checks the input path.

false: does not check the input path
parameters.help_zh:
是否检查指定的工作流支持输入路径。此处建议您选择检查（true），避免因路径出错而导致的错误。取值：

true：检查

false：不检查
parameters.name: input_unbind

parameters.help_en: The ID of the category to which the media file belongs. The ID cannot be a negative number
parameters.help_zh: 媒体所属类目ID。不允许为负数
parameters.name: cate_id

parameters.help_en:
The override parameters.

Example 1: Override subtitles for HLS packaging: `{"WebVTTSubtitleOverrides",[{"RefActivityName":"subtitleNode","WebVTTSubtitleURL":"http://test.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/example1.vtt"}]}`.
Example 2: Override subtitles for DASH packaging: `{"subtitleTransNodeName":{"InputConfig":{"Format":"stl","InputFile":{"URL":"http://subtitleBucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/example/CENG.stl"}}}}`
parameters.help_zh:
覆盖参数。

示例1：HLS打包字幕覆盖`{“WebVTTSubtitleOverrides”,[{“RefActivityName”:”subtitleNode”,”WebVTTSubtitleURL”:”http://test.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/example1.vtt"}]}`。
示例2：DASH打包字幕覆盖` {“subtitleTransNodeName”:{“InputConfig”:{“Format”:”stl”,”InputFile”:{“URL”:”http://subtitleBucket.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/package/example/CENG.stl"}}}}`
parameters.name: override_params

CensorState.description_en:
The content moderation status of the video. Valid values:

Initiated: The video is uploaded but the moderation is not completed.

Pass: The video is uploaded and passed the moderation
CensorState.description_zh:
视频审核状态。取值：

Initiated：初始（上传成功审核未完成）。

Pass：通过（上传成功审核已通过）

CoverURL.description_en: The URL of the cover image

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the media file was created. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式的 UTC 时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ

Description.description_en: The description. The description cannot exceed 1,024 bytes in length
Description.description_zh: 描述。长度不超过1024个字节

Duration.description_en: The duration of the media file

State.description_en: The file status. Default value: Normal
State.description_zh: 文件状态。此处默认为Normal（正常）

Format.description_en: The format. Valid values: mov, mp4, m4a, 3gp, 3g2, and mj2

Fps.description_en: The frame rate of the media file

Height.description_en: The height of the media file

PublishState.description_en:
The publish status of the media file, which indicates whether the media file is published. Valid values:

Initiated: The media file is in the initial state.
UnPublish: The media file is not published. The playback permission of the OSS file is Private.
Published: The media file is published. The playback permission of the OSS file is Default
PublishState.description_zh:
媒体发布状态，表示是否对外发布媒体。取值：

Initiated：初始。
UnPublish：未发布，OSS播放文件权限为Private。
Published：已发布，OSS播放文件权限为Default

Size.description_en: The size of the media file

Title.description_en: The title of the media file. The title cannot exceed 128 bytes in length
Title.description_zh: 媒体标题。长度不超过128个字节

Width.description_en: The width of the media file
